rows.summary: Fixes the typo in greet() so it returns 'hello ' + name instead of 'helo ' + name, matching the expected value in apps/web/tests/greeter.test.js.
Make sumTo include n itself by changing the loop condition from i < n to i <= n, so sumTo(5) returns 15.
Fix add() in apps/web/src/math.js so it returns a + b instead of a - b (add(2,3) was returning -1).
Change the strict comparison in isAdult to >= so that age 18 counts as an adult.
Add the missing return statement in total so it returns the accumulated sum instead of undefined.
Change the default tax rate in withTax from 0.2 (20%) to 0.25 (25%), so withTax(100) returns 125.
Make sameName compare names case-insensitively so sameName('Ann', 'ann') is true.
Fix the off-by-one in last(): index arr.length - 1 instead of arr.length, so last([1, 2, 3]) returns 3 rather than undefined.
Fix ratio() to divide x by y instead of y by x, so ratio(10, 4) returns 2.5.
Fix capitalize so it keeps the rest of the string: s.slice(2) dropped the second character, making 'hello' become 'Hllo'.

rows.summary: toCents multiplied dollars by 10 instead of 100, so formatPrice(1.5) produced 15 cents and printed '$0.15'. Multiplying by 100 yields 150 cents and '$1.50'.
Make average return 0 for an empty list instead of NaN by guarding the division.
Add a double(n) function returning n * 2 and export it alongside triple in apps/web/src/mathx.js.
Export the already-defined slugify function from apps/web/src/util.js so require('../src/util.js').slugify is defined and the slug test can pass.
